newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end firmer, recover after three-day decline.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end firmer, recover after three-day decline.

text.p: Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures closed firmer and at their session highs on Thursday, after falling nearly two yen during the three previous sessions.

Buy-backs from previous sellers protected the downside above 124.60 for a second day on Thursday, amid a lack of fresh bearish factors since last Friday's suspension of business at Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co, traders said.
Tokyo stocks cut earlier gains toward the close on Thursday, also providing support for JGBs, they said.
June ended at 125.40, up 0.37 from Wednesday.
